detail.longDescription: Alright, "Cheesy Exode" chapter 1 is completed, we have a new tunnel configured, on a new, stable, host, and all duplication is rolling smoothly, slowly uncluttering the local cluster For more context, I got a new, bigger, drive on one of the remote host, which is now the master tunnel for that DC This also means I am moving away from Proxmox in favour for my home baked Debian spin-off Sad to loose Proxmox from the cluster, but I couldn't afford the resource overhead, and didn't have any reason to keep it other than "but I can play with it" Now 2 more hosts need to follow the same path, and I'll be ready to rock 🪨 # selfhosted # homelab # dc # proxmox # datacenter # k3s # debian # migration # redundancy # highavailability # ha # selfhosting # selfhost
